title: Children's furniture line importing into Denver

input.what: Children's furniture brand importing kids' beds and desks

assumptions: A children's furniture line (beds and desks for children, wood) imported and sold online from Denver, with no store (the seller path). Colorado's company, tax and employer filings as strict/denver-franchise-tea.json and gold/denver-coffee.json; the LLC is formed (no entity given). Children's furniture takes CPSC's Children's Product Certificate and tracking labels; Colorado's packaging EPR is conditional on the revenue threshold.
